evidence: `completion_choice` (WilsonBulk/Spectral/Joint.lean:44) gives only `Freezer`, the r = 0 dual→primal bound on the joint inverse. `Freezer.back` (Loops/UniformMatrix.lean:278) is applied only to amFilm, i.e. P_μ (`pebbles_frozen`, Films/ThinTrace.lean:304-306), and the inverse of legionF appears only in `Ticket`/`Play` (Films/Contact.lean:183,201) with no norm bound. So ‖D^r(A_μ^{−1})‖ ≤ Q_r(C^ins) for r = 1, 2 and the μ²-scaled block bounds are absent, while `thin_doubled` (AuxReferences.lean:476) covers only the P_μ³ trace.

`completion_choice` (WilsonBulk/Spectral/Joint.lean:44-52) concludes `Poster η` and `Freezer … η C`. `Freezer` (Loops/UniformMatrix.lean:270-272) is only invertibility and a `serial` bound on (K p)⁻¹, i.e. r = 0. Other Freezer instances (AuxReferences.lean:374-398, ComplexGap.lean:338) are also r = 0, and none states D^r(A_μ⁻¹) for r = 1, 2 or the μ²-scaled block bounds.
